backend/main.mo: Motoko actor storing inquiries in memory, allowing submission with validation and retrieval of all inquiries.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, related files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON mapping of frontend file paths to short descriptive summaries of their functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/theme variable definitions for light and dark modes with global styling tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting up fonts and root div for the React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with routes for all major pages, wrapped in the SiteLayout.
frontend/src/components/CategoryHierarch: Renders a grid of subcategory cards with product-type previews and navigates to selected subcategory pages.
frontend/src/components/ProductQuickView: Modal displaying product details with glass styling, escape/scroll handling, and inquiry button.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Renders a dynamic footer that adapts styling based on the current route and includes company info, quick links, contact details, and attribution.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Implements a responsive header with scroll-based styling, navigation links, and a mobile menu tied to router state.
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Defines the main page layout by wrapping routed content with the site header and footer.
Displays a subcategory card with auto‑generated descriptions and placeholder images based on category and subcategory.
frontend/src/data/productTaxonomy.ts: Exports structured product taxonomy including categories, subcategories, and product types with associated metadata.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context for Internet Identity authentication, handling login, logout, identity persistence, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useParallax.ts: Adds a scroll‑based parallax transform effect with reduced‑motion support.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exposes a mutation hook for submitting inquiry forms via the backend actor and invalidating inquiry queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useReducedMotion.ts: Hook that returns whether the user prefers reduced motion using a matchMedia listener.
frontend/src/hooks/useRevealOnce.ts: Hook that reveals an element once using IntersectionObserver and returns a ref and state.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS file defining design tokens, gradients, and custom utility styles for the frontend.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, React Query, Internet Identity provider, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Static About page describing the company, mission, and differentiators using styled sections.
frontend/src/pages/CataloguePage.tsx: Page promoting the product catalogue with features, benefits, and a CTA to request it.
frontend/src/pages/CategoryPage.tsx: Dynamic product category page showing a banner, customization note, subcategories, and inquiry navigation.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Contact form page with validation, category prefill, inquiry submission, and success state UI.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page component rendering hero, crafting, and showcase sections with parallax, reveal hooks, and navigation buttons.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Displays product categories in a grid with images and navigation to category pages.
frontend/src/pages/SubcategoryPage.tsx: Shows products within a selected subcategory, provides navigation, inquiry actions, and a product quick‑view modal.
frontend/src/utils/slug.ts: Provides helpers to convert text to URL-friendly slugs and back.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for the project.
project_state.json: Metadata describing the project’s state and requirements, focused on refining the Home page design and motion.
